title: Yuvion LLM: An Adversarially-Aware Large Language Model for Content And AI Safety
title_zh: Yuvion LLM：面向内容安全与 AI Safety 的对抗感知大语言模型
abstract_en: As large language models are increasingly deployed in real-world systems, safety failures can still lead to harmful outputs and dangerous misuse. We argue that the essence of safety is adversarial: many failures arise not from natural inputs alone, but from strategic attempts to evade model policies and safeguards. However, existing general-purpose model development largely overlook this adversarial nature, and often remain insufficient for realistic safety scenarios involving planning, tool use, and multi-step reasoning, causing measured safety performance to overestimate real deployment robustness. To address this gap, we present Yuvion LLM, a large language model built for adversarially robust content safety and broader AI safety. Yuvion LLM treats adversarial robustness and agentic capability as first-class objectives. Its pipeline combines adversarially aware data construction, knowledge-enhanced continued pretraining, and policy-grounded multi-task safety post-training, including risk-aware supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning-based policy optimization, together with safety-aware agentic reinforcement learning for tool use and multi-step reasoning in complex safety scenarios. We further introduce the Yuvion LLM RiskEval (YLRE), a collection of 93 benchmarks across four evaluation categories, covering diverse open and internal evaluations with a focus on safety, adversarial robustness, and real-world capability requirements. Across these evaluations, Yuvion LLM demonstrates clear advantages on safety-focused benchmarks and particularly strong robustness under adversarial conditions, while maintaining solid overall capability. Notably, Yuvion-8B outperforms most state-of-the-art baselines, including substantially larger models such as GPT-5.4 and Qwen3-MAX, on several safety tasks.
abstract_zh: 本文认为，大语言模型的安全本质具有强对抗性：许多安全失败并非来自普通输入，而是来自有策略地规避模型政策与防护机制的攻击。现有通用模型开发往往低估这种对抗性，尤其在涉及规划、工具使用和多步推理的真实安全场景中，离线安全评测可能高估部署鲁棒性。为此，论文提出 Yuvion LLM，一个面向对抗鲁棒内容安全与更广义 AI Safety 构建的大语言模型。其训练流程将对抗鲁棒性与智能体能力作为核心目标，结合对抗感知数据构建、知识增强继续预训练、基于政策的多任务安全后训练，包括风险感知监督微调、基于强化学习的政策优化，以及面向工具使用和复杂多步安全场景的安全感知智能体强化学习。论文还提出 Yuvion LLM RiskEval（YLRE），包含 93 个基准，覆盖四类评测，强调安全性、对抗鲁棒性与真实世界能力需求。实验显示，Yuvion LLM 在安全相关基准上表现突出，尤其在对抗条件下鲁棒性强，同时保持较好的通用能力；其中 Yuvion-8B 在若干安全任务上超过多数 SOTA baseline，甚至优于 GPT-5.4、Qwen3-MAX 等更大模型。
key_points_zh: 核心观点是将 LLM 安全问题建模为对抗性问题，强调真实攻击者会通过策略性提示、规划和多步交互绕过安全策略。
Yuvion LLM 的训练管线包括对抗感知数据构建、知识增强 continued pretraining，以及基于安全政策的多任务 post-training。
后训练阶段结合风险感知 SFT、基于 RL 的 policy optimization，并引入 safety-aware agentic RL，以提升工具使用和多步推理场景下的安全鲁棒性。
论文提出 Yuvion LLM RiskEval（YLRE），包含 93 个 benchmark，覆盖安全、对抗鲁棒性和真实世界能力等四类评测。
实验显示 Yuvion-8B 在多个安全任务上超过多数 SOTA baseline，并在部分评测中优于 GPT-5.4、Qwen3-MAX 等更大模型。

llm_assessment.comment: The paper is mainly a safety-focused LLM and evaluation suite, with only limited connection to reusable agent harnesses or trajectory-driven improvement.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这篇论文主要是安全模型与评测套件，与可复用智能体运行框架或轨迹驱动改进的关联较弱。
